verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own materials say a single natural-language sentence sets up an agent's name, role, skills and behaviors, and that the system assembles the right agents for a task. The composer can open a topic, create a task or start a page, and onboarding suggests tasks from what you describe about your work. These show natural-language control of key workflows, but the evidence is marketing and changelog copy rather than detailed docs on operating the product broadly through commands. Missing for 10: documentation that settings, navigation and administration can be driven by natural language; detailed usage docs for natural-language agent and task creation; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: One sentence to start. Names, roles, skills, and behaviors are set up automatically.
Auto team formation: The system assembles the right Agents for the task.
The composer switches between Chat, Task, and Note, so the same box can open a Topic, create a Task, or start a page.
Onboarding now suggests concrete first Tasks based on what you tell it about your work
